description: Re-registers the Gmail push watch as the Gmail card's Re-arm does, so new email reaches Sergio in real time again, and stores the new expiry and history baseline. Safe to call repeatedly; nothing is sent to clients. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: rearm_gmail_watch
title: Re-arm Gmail real-time notifications
